```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)

# OSM data

OSM <- st_read("../data/wk5/greater-london-261104-free.shp/gis_osm_pois_free_1.shp")%>%
  st_transform(., 27700) %>%
  #select hotels only
  filter(fclass == 'hotel')
```
```{r}
# Airbnb data
Airbnb <- read_csv("../data/wk5/listings.csv") %>%
  # longitude is considered x value here, latitude is y
  st_as_sf(., coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), #转换为空间数据，默认会把原来的两个坐标列转换为一个 geometry 列，并删除原来的经纬度列。
                   crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(., 27700)%>%
    #select entire places that are available all year
    filter(room_type == 'Entire home/apt' & availability_365 =='365')


#London Borough data is already in 277000
Londonborough <- st_read("../data/wk1/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp")%>%
  st_transform(., 27700)
```
```{r}
# load world cities
Worldcities <- st_read("../data/wk5/World_Cities/World_Cities.shp") %>%
  st_transform(., 27700)
```
```{r}
# filter based on key cities
Worldcities2 <- Worldcities %>%
  filter(CNTRY_NAME=='United Kingdom'&
           Worldcities$CITY_NAME=='Birmingham'|
           Worldcities$CITY_NAME=='London'|
           Worldcities$CITY_NAME=='Edinburgh')

# load UK outline
UK_outline <- st_read("../data/wk5/gadm41_GBR_shp/gadm41_GBR_0.shp")%>%
  st_transform(., 27700)
```
```{r}
Hotels <-  st_join(Londonborough, OSM)

Airbnbs <-  st_join(Londonborough, Airbnb)

head(Hotels)
```

```{r}
Hotels_sum <- Hotels %>%
  # we need to list the columns we want to keep in the summarise
  group_by(., GSS_CODE, NAME)%>%
  # for each group count the number of rows and store in a column called accomodation count.
  summarise(`Accomodation count` = n())

Airbnb_sum <- Airbnbs %>%
  group_by(., GSS_CODE, NAME)%>%
  summarise(`Accomodation count` = n())
```
```{r}
# the st_join data = 0 Hotels
Hotels %>%
  filter(NAME=="Barking and Dagenham")
```
```{r}
# the group by and summarise data = 1 Hotel!
Hotels_sum %>%
  filter(NAME=="Barking and Dagenham")
```
```{r}
Hotels_example <-st_contains(Londonborough, OSM)

Hotels_example
```
```{r}
Accomodation_contained <- Londonborough%>%
  mutate(hotels_n = lengths(st_contains(., OSM)))%>%
  mutate(airbnbs_n = lengths(st_contains(., Airbnbs)))
```
```{r}
# the group by and summarise data = 1 Hotel!
Accomodation_contained %>%
  filter(NAME=="Barking and Dagenham")
```

```{r}
remotes::install_github("r-tmap/tmap")
```
``` 
library(tmap)

# change to "view" for an interactive map
tmap_mode("plot")
```
```{r}
# set the shape
tm1 <- tm_shape(Accomodation_contained) + 
  # set the map layer
  # try changing this to tm_symbols()
  tm_polygons("hotels_n",
              col = "black", lwd=0.5, lty="dashed",)
  #lwd=0.5设置边界线宽为 0.5，lty = "dashed"设置边界为虚线）

# plot the map
tm1
```
```{r}
tm_no_map_layer <- tm_shape(Accomodation_contained) + 
  # there is no tm_polygons() if we just want the map with no spatial data
  tm_borders(col = "darkblue")

tm_no_map_layer
```
```{r}
# plot each map
tm1 <- tm_shape(Accomodation_contained) + 
  tm_polygons(fill ="hotels_n",
              col = "black", 
              lwd =0.5,
              lty="dashed",
              fill.chart = tm_chart_violin(),
              # above this was the same as before
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals( #设置数值分级
                values="brewer.bu_pu",# 蓝紫色系
                n=5,   # 5 个等级
                style="jenks"))# 自然断点法

tm1
```
```{r}
library(colorblindcheck)
cols4all::c4a_gui()# 打开交互式配色选择器
# cols4all：用于选择和评估地图配色方案
# c4a_gui()：打开交互式配色工具（GUI）
# 可以比较不同配色，并检查颜色是否适合色觉障碍人群
# Sequential（顺序型）：适用于酒店数量等连续数值
# Diverging（发散型）：适用于高于或低于平均值的数据
# Qualitative（定性型）：适用于不同类别的数据
```
```{r}
stats <- Accomodation_contained %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% # 删除空间几何列，转为普通数据框
  dplyr::select(hotels_n, airbnbs_n) %>%  # 只保留酒店和Airbnb数量
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    min = min,
    max = max,
    mean = mean,
    median = median,
    sd = sd
  )))
```

```{r}
library(classInt)

# Get Jenks breaks for 5 classes
breaks <- Accomodation_contained%>%
  st_drop_geometry()%>% 
  #need a numeric vector not a dataframe or tibble
  pull(airbnbs_n) %>%   # 提取 Airbnb 数量这一列          
  classIntervals(., n = 5, style = "jenks")
  
breaks$brks  # 查看计算出的分界点
```
```{r}
tm1 <- tm_shape(Accomodation_contained) +
    tm_polygons(
      fill = c("hotels_n", "airbnbs_n"),
      fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(values = "brewer.blues",
                                      # 使用蓝色渐变配色
                                      breaks=breaks$brks),
      # set the legend
      fill.legend = tm_legend(title="Accomodation count",
                              title.size=0.85,
                              size=0.8,
                              # plot outside of the main map
                              #explained below
                              position=tm_pos_out("right",    #把图例放在地图绘图区外侧
                                                  "center",
                                                  pos.v = "center")),
      # all facets share the same legend
      fill.free = FALSE)+  # 两张地图共享颜色分级标准
  # make 2 rows for the facets
  tm_facets(nrow=2)# 两张地图上下排列

tm1
```
```{r}
# change headings or remove

tm2 <- tm1+
  tm_layout(panel.labels=c("Hotels", "Airbnb"),#给两张分面地图分别添加标题
            panel.show = TRUE #显示分面标题区域。
            #panel.label.bg.color = "transparent",
            )+
  
  tm_compass(type= "arrow",
            size=1.8, 
            position = tm_pos_out("right", 
                                  "center",
                                  pos.h= -0.05,# 调整水平位置
                                  pos.v =0.9))+# 调整垂直位置
  tm_scalebar(text.size = 0.7,
              width=10,
              breaks=c(0,10,20),# 比例尺刻度
              position = tm_pos_out("right",
                                    "center", 
                                    pos.h=0.075,
                                    pos.v =0.9))+
  # we could use tm_credits to place sub-titles like (A) or (B)
  # on the map.
  tm_credits("(c) OpenStreetMap contrbutors and Air b n b",
             size=0.6,
             position = tm_pos_out("center",
                                   "bottom",
                                   pos.v = 1.5,
                                   pos.h=-0.02))

tm2
```

```{r}
newbb <- c(xmin=-296000, ymin=5408, xmax=655696, ymax=1000000)
  
UK_outlinecrop <- UK_outline$geometry %>%
  st_crop(., newbb)
```
```{r}
tm3 <- tm_shape(UK_outlinecrop)+  #选择图层数据
  tm_polygons(col="darkslategray1")+ #绘制多边形
    tm_layout(frame=FALSE)+ #隐藏地图外围的边框
  tm_shape(Worldcities2) +
    #adds the city points
    tm_symbols(shape=20,
               fill = "orange",
               #outline colour
               col="black",
               size=0.8)+
        #add the city labels, x and y move the label around the point
    tm_text("CITY_NAME", xmod=-1, ymod=-0.5) #绘制文字标签

tm3
```
```{r}
# st_bbox gives the bounding x and y coordinates 
Londonbb <- st_bbox(Accomodation_contained, #提取空间范围
                    crs = st_crs(Accomodation_contained))%>% #保留坐标系信息
# st_as_sfc coverts the coordinates to an sf object
  st_as_sfc() #把坐标范围转换成空间几何

tm4 <- tm3 +
  tm_shape(Londonbb)+ 
  tm_borders(col = "grey40", lwd = 3)+ #只绘制矩形的边界，不填充内部 # 边界线宽
    tm_layout(frame=FALSE,
            bg.color = "transparent") ## 透明背景
```
```{r}
inset <- tmap_grob(tm4, asp=1.1)# 将英国位置图 tm4 转换为可嵌入的 grob 图形对象

final_map<- tm2+
  tm_inset(inset,# 要插入的小地图
             position = tm_pos_out("right", "center")) # 放在主地图右侧外部
tmap_save(final_map, "prac5_data/2_facet.png", width = 8, height = 6, units="in", dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

accom_long <- Accomodation_contained %>%
  # drop geometry for plotting
  st_drop_geometry() %>%  # 删除空间几何列
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(hotels_n, airbnbs_n),
    names_to = "accom_type",
    values_to = "count"
  )
```
```{r}
violin <- accom_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = accom_type, 
             # number
             y = count, 
             # hotels or airbnb 
             fill = accom_type)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, #不将核密度估计的小提琴形状截断在实际最小值和最大值处
              color = "grey30", 
              alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  labs( #设置图表文字
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "black"
  ) +
  # change the labels from the column names to..
scale_x_discrete(labels = c("hotels_n" = "Hotels", #修改 X 轴的类别名称
                            "airbnbs_n" = "Airbnbs"))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  theme(
    # no legend
    legend.position = "none", # 隐藏图例
    # all text to black
    text = element_text(color = "black"),         # set all text to black
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),    # axis tick labels
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),   # axis titles (if used)
    plot.title = element_text(color = "black")    # title (if used)
  )
```
